name: 🖐️ Heroes Tower
desc:
😜 Welcome to HERO TOWER!
The silliest, craziest, most unpredictable obby on Roblox is finally here!
Acquire fun and rare powers and race with your friends!

🎮 Features
🎯 Dodge troll traps, bonking hammers, and flying players!
🎁 Unlock funny tools, wacky accessories, and secret powers!
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and show who rules the tower!
🎉 New surprises, gifts, and  fun moments every day!

😈 Trolls are EVERYWHERE… Stay sharp or get trolled!
🛡️ Kid-friendly chaos — no bad vibes, just giggles and bonks!

👥 Join our group for awesome perks!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/7343218/Blandy-Studios#!/about

Inspired by Slap Tower and silly obbies, built with love for max fun!
🧼 Some assets are free models or original creations.
